value.rationale: The 2026 mean-distance literature contains higher-dimensional counterexamples, so identifying geometric classes preserving all convex-function comparisons is motivated. The iff classifies exactly when an arbitrary orthogonal product inherits volume-to-surface convex order and proves no bad factor can be repaired by products. It supplies high-dimensional curved and unlike-radius polyhedral examples outside published sufficient classes, all separately convex multi-point inequalities, and an equality-sharp quantitative strong-convexity defect.
